title: Toronto death ray inventor and Mossad missing time

tellings.quote: I'm familiar with a with a newspaper clipping from Toronto, Canada from the 19 late '50s, early '60s that talked about how there was a gentleman that invented a death ray, but for the people that came to go visit him, there were some Mossad representatives that went to go see him. They reported missing time,

plain: A Toronto newspaper story from the late 1950s or early 1960s told of a man who had invented a death ray, and said that visitors who came to see him, including people from Mossad, Israel's intelligence service, reported missing time, a stretch of time they could not account for. A guest named Dave Rossi tells Michels he knows the clipping, without naming the paper or the date. If true, something about the inventor or his device affected the minds of those who came near it.
